name: inprocess-obi-apb-ibex-timer-zipdma-16w-address-fuzz
notes: trigger_writes and status_offsets repeat the values already used by configs/scenarios/inprocess-irq-pulp-timer-profile.json; the entry re-checks them against the timer register map and interrupt declarations
dma_window must not overlap the APB target window; the timer owns 0x40000000..0x40000fff
the timer declares 50 MHz, the CPU 50 MHz and the ZipDMA a nominal 1 Hz simulation rate, so assume_single_clock states that one host tick drives all three models

f1_program_words 16 declares a 16-word straight-line F1 program in the fixed trampoline slot.  f1_allow_address_forms additionally admits a memory word whose base register is statically proven to hold data_base + d: ADDI xd,x18,k; ADDI xm,x0,k + ADD xd,x18,xm; LUI xm,0 + ADDI xm,xm,k + ADD xd,x18,xm; and ADDI xm,x0,c + ANDI xm,xm,window-4 + ADD xd,x18,xm.  A computed base must carry immediate 0 and its proven range must stay 4-byte aligned inside the declared 64-byte window; the legacy x18 + immediate form is unchanged.  Branches, compressed parcels and CSR words are still not admitted.  Evidence: runs/round1-f1-a/ (fixed-address, fuzz-20).
